purpose: Operator health dashboard combining instance health, source freshness, actionable warnings, incidents, AI spend, infrastructure diagnostics, authentication, telemetry, workers, SLO evidence and maintenance controls.
primaryGoal: Determine whether the instance is healthy, identify the affected subsystem, and reach the appropriate recovery or diagnostic action without mistaking missing evidence for health or failure.

dataSources.name: useSystemHealth
dataSources.behavior: Shared admin query; standard polling, AbortSignal and accepted HTTP 503 payloads. useDataState live provenance with two-minute max age. Overall hero also incorporates maintenance, extended database, workers and authentication.

dataSources.name: Page-local extended/version/update/backup-stat/worker queries
dataSources.behavior: system-status query-key prefix; extended health, backup stats and workers poll every 30 seconds, version every minute, updates hourly with hourly staleTime. Extended health accepts 503. Functions do not accept or forward query cancellation.
dataSources.verification: Source matched; backend payload semantics and runtime unverified.

dataSources.name: Authentication, backup history/configuration, maintenance and vehicles
dataSources.behavior: Shared typed hooks and safeArray backup responses; successful-backup recency uses first completed run, expiry warnings use floor days and seven-day threshold, backup stale threshold is strictly greater than seven days. Maintenance takes precedence in overall status. Fleet-wide operator view does not introduce a competing workspace picker.
dataSources.verification: Endpoint registrations inspected; list ordering and actual payloads unverified.

dataSources.name: useStatusLiveSSE
dataSources.behavior: Direct EventSource endpoint, not request() prefixing; credentialed stream, object-frame parser, retained snapshot, reconnecting/offline/live states and exponential retry capped at 30 seconds. Page reads connection state and event time but ignores snapshot; ordinary polling continues when connected.
dataSources.verification: Source matched; stream traffic and reconnection unverified.

dataSources.name: Active incidents, recent incident history and manual incident logging
dataSources.behavior: Independent 30-second polling lists; normalizes nullable arrays; mutation invalidates status-incidents. Modal collects title, severity, status, affected component names and initial message; validation, pending state, toast and dirty-close confirmation retained.
dataSources.verification: Source registered child slash paths; actual slash normalization and mutation behavior unverified; no writes exercised.

dataSources.name: AI spend watch
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only for local/cloud AI mode. UTC today, prior seven-day average, midnight projection, largest contributor and cap risk are distinct evidence. Micro-cent values become USD display amounts only; retains insufficient-history, quiet, unusual-pace and new-paid-spend explanations.
dataSources.verification: Frontend endpoint inspected; exact backend registration not located in the bounded router search; backend owner and behavior unverified, not asserted missing.

dataSources.name: Telemetry polling and streaming
dataSources.behavior: 15-second polling status plus shared MQTT query; per-VIN join uses newest valid stream/poll timestamp. Sending <5 minutes, slow <30 minutes, stale thereafter; no valid timestamp is labelled offline but explicitly caveated as missing evidence. Battery, vehicle state, VIN tail and next poll retained.
dataSources.verification: Route groups source-inspected; conditional polling-handler availability, mounted payloads and history semantics unverified.

dataSources.name: AnomalyInlineRow
dataSources.behavior: Uses first configured vehicle only; query enabled only with vehicle ID, shared slow staleTime, AbortSignal. Shows count, top signal, relative timestamp and anomaly-detection navigation; null/no anomaly hides row.
dataSources.verification: Source matched; intentionally sampled scope, not all-fleet anomaly coverage.

dataSources.name: SLO history and personal target
dataSources.behavior: Independent 60-second query, default 30d, target default 99 persisted under teslasync.status.slo.target. Historical percentage only rendered for historical_source=series; finite current healthy/total counts remain independent. Local target edit/save/cancel and Enter/Escape; controls suppressed for snapshot-only evidence.
dataSources.verification: Source matched; backend series support and persisted-browser behavior unverified. Specialist SLO window is not assumed to be the workspace date range.

dataSources.name: Maintenance scheduling and clearing
dataSources.behavior: Shared current-state query. Operator can enter local start, duration and message; submitted mode=maintenance and until=start+duration, with no submitted start field. Clear sends mode=ok and null until. Live-only mutation, read-only notice, validation, pending, toast and discard guard remain.
dataSources.verification: Frontend writes inventoried only. Future activation semantics are unverified and must not be inferred from the component comment.

states.initialLoading: PageLayout is intentionally not a global loading/error boundary. Eleven source banners render individually, but page:513 initial health loading replaces the entire substantive page with StatusPageSkeleton.
states.empty: Components remain visible with unavailable text; worker and telemetry cards distinguish unloaded versus empty lists; IncidentHistory states no recorded incidents does not establish uptime. ResourcesPanel owns an empty-text prop.
states.error: SourceContent retries fatal or absent primary sources; StaleRefreshWarning preserves retained data. Incident/history/AI/SLO/maintenance/telemetry add their own source-specific recovery.
states.staleOffline: Hero becomes unknown when health errors or exceeds two minutes; SSE pill separates live/reconnecting/offline. Worker/telemetry summaries receive retained flags. Other dependent health summaries can still use retained raw values; no claim they prove current health.
states.successDisabled: Refresh is disabled while health fetches, maintenance controls use operational canWrite and pending states, incident form has pending and dirty-close handling; SLO keeps target editing validation.

issues.detail: Initial health fetch gates independently loaded incidents, AI, history and diagnostics behind the whole-page skeleton.
issues.fix: Keep independent sections mounted with source-specific initial state; retain hero skeleton and avoid exposing invented zero measurements.

issues.detail: hasAttention hides ActionItemsPanel even though shared owner has an explicit empty state; absence of warnings can also mean prerequisite sources are missing.
issues.fix: Keep the section reachable and distinguish verified no-actions from unresolved sources; do not call unknown evidence healthy.

issues.detail: Successful zero-active response returns null and removes the only mounted Log incident action supplied by this page.
issues.fix: Preserve a reachable log action when empty while keeping the supplementary active list low-noise.

issues.detail: Unavailable/error anomaly query is indistinguishable from zero anomalies and uses first-vehicle sampling without visible scope disclosure.
issues.fix: Show sampled vehicle/source trust through existing HealthRow/feedback patterns; preserve first-vehicle behavior unless separately authorized.

visualIssues.detail: Every status applies a 60px colored glow; configuration also supplies saturated colored headline/icon/ring emphasis.
visualIssues.fix: Remove default glow in existing owner and use restrained surface, semantic Badge/icon and primary text; preserve all five statuses and CTA.

visualIssues.detail: Detail links use hardcoded cyan tint/ring/focus while footer at 855 uses fixed-white surface effects; diagnostic dependencies also use fixed-white divider/surface classes.
visualIssues.fix: Use canonical surface/border/focus/button tokens; keep semantic warning accents only where they convey severity.

visualIssues.detail: Raw typography classes and English update/notes copy bypass existing typography/localization owners.
visualIssues.fix: Adopt PanelTitle/Text/Caption and existing translation mechanism while retaining current/latest versions, checked time and release warning.

visualIssues.detail: ResourcesPanel is supplied only rows, leaving title and empty message at raw-English shared defaults; StatusHero at 521 likewise receives no localized headline.
visualIssues.fix: Pass localized title/emptyText/headline through existing props instead of inventing another renderer.

visualIssues.detail: Anomalies label, in-24h summary and relative-time units are hardcoded; LiveStatusPill:28-41 and IncidentsCard:49-56 have separate English relative formatters.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse current date/relative-time localization mechanisms while preserving source timestamps and sampling context.

visualIssues.detail: Worker instance/group panels repeat fixed-white fill/border/divider classes instead of theme-aware neutral hierarchy.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border variables, retain status labels and per-instance diagnostic errors.

architectureIssues.detail: Five read queries are defined in the page with devtools functions lacking AbortSignal; SLO and telemetry polling also define queries in presentation components.
architectureIssues.fix: Move orchestration through existing domain hook owners, forward signal, and explicitly preserve cache identities, accepted-status policy, intervals and enablement.

architectureIssues.detail: Comment says SSE drops polling, but snapshot is unused and no query interval depends on liveState.
architectureIssues.fix: Document actual independent stream metadata versus REST measurement behavior; do not disable polling without a validated equivalent snapshot/cache integration.

architectureIssues.detail: Hash effect opens operator diagnostics, but scrollToSection at 242 does not open disclosures before calculating target coordinates. Direct initial hash scrolling into hidden content needs validation.
architectureIssues.fix: Open owning details/accordion before scroll/focus using existing disclosure APIs, preserve all IDs and route hashes.

architectureIssues.detail: Page injects global print CSS; details { open: true } is not a valid CSS mechanism for expanding disclosures and may affect panels beyond this page.
architectureIssues.fix: Integrate scoped print behavior with the existing print owner; verify diagnostic disclosures expand without changing normal open state.

architectureIssues.detail: UI accepts a future local start but sends only current maintenance mode and end timestamp. Source cannot substantiate comment's future-activation promise.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must verify backend contract and accurately communicate current capability before altering workflow; retain all user-entered details until resolved.

architectureIssues.detail: Generic percentage maps >=90 to critical usage, yet page:382 passes healthy-workers percentage; 100% healthy is therefore red critical, opposite of source meaning.
architectureIssues.fix: Add an explicit utilization versus healthy-ratio semantic variant to this owner, or omit usage bars for health ratios; preserve counts and unknown percent.

architectureIssues.detail: vehicleCount uses undefined -> 0 for the triage summary, although telemetry detail preserves missing list as unknown; formatUptime in helpers.tsx:49 maps invalid values to 0m.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep unknown distinct from measured zero at display boundaries with existing numeric validation/formatting, without changing raw payloads.

Worker API logs /api-logs and complete instance host/error detail.

dataBehavior: Preserve status precedence and normalization, canonical snake_case component-key deduplication, component names/counts and unknown status.
Retain two-minute hero staleness, five-second clock tick, source-specific freshness/provenance and retained payload warnings.
Retain current query keys, polling/refetch/stale policy, enabled guards, accepted 503 health bodies and credentials; no automatic SSE cache rewrite.
Retain token expiry dates and seven-day warnings; successful backup recency and config-dependent no-backup warning; unhealthy worker names.

Resources: acquired/total/idle pool connections, storage source string, table/row/position counts, goroutines, healthy/total workers and uptime. Database also shows latency; never invent CPU/memory/disk capacity.
System metadata: app/chart/Go version, OS/architecture, uptime and goroutines.
Telemetry: five source counts, four liveness counts, newest stream-or-poll source/time, VIN tail/name/state, battery and next poll. Unknown timestamp is not measured outage.
Workers: type and instance rollups, replicated types, per-instance host/status/latency/error and scaling environment-variable guidance.
Incidents: manual fields, status/severity, affected components, timestamps, update count and recent-ten history caveat.
AI: audit-only spend caveats, separate UTC windows, provider/model/feature driver, cap and projection explanations; preserve source micro-cent precision.
SLO: historical_source distinction and finite values; no uptime inferred from missing history.
Maintenance: current state/message/until, source write guards and local date handling; future activation remains an integration unknown.
Use current number/date/unit preferences only at display boundary; no API, backend, raw SI or cache value changes authorized.
preservation.lineCountPolicy: No implementation or extraction performed. Future page plus extracted same-feature components must retain at least 70% of original baseline unless genuinely simpler with complete capability evidence.
